featured_reviews.review_text:
I visited the hospital for blood donation with a genuine intention to help others. During the screening, I was told that my hemoglobin level was low. However, after further tests, everything came out normal and there was no health issue found.

I feel the staff handling the blood donation process need better training and proper knowledge. Hiring inexperienced staff without enough medical understanding can create unnecessary fear and confusion for donors. Because of this, people who come forward for a good cause may feel discouraged from donating blood again.

I hope the hospital management improves staff training and ensures accurate guidance is given to donors in the future.

featured_reviews.review_text: They are a shame on humanity. They take a non refundable deposit of ₹450 , do not give receipt, no terms clearly explained. My dad was being operated upon in SUVARNA Hospital Borivali west and we had requested for reservation of blood on 19.03.2026. Fortunately we did not need blood on 20.03 and 21.03 but we were in need of blood unit for 22.03.2026.When we called them, they said it is over 24 hours so you will have to pay deposit again . Basically a con game to get ₹450 as advance and refuse to accept it later ( within 48 hours). This is absolute inhuman behaviour from the blood bank. They will have a curse of a million people if they continue to operate with such foolish money mindset with no respect to customer inconvenience and do not bother to give any receipts or  explain these terms before making reservation. They should be closed down on unethical business practices.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Had visited here for voluntary blood donation. The experience was very good as the staff were courteous and professional.
During the donation I felt a bit uneasy, and the staff handled it promptly and calmly.
After the donation, they offered Frooti and provided a certificate, donor card, and a bottle as a memento, which felt thoughtful. Since I was not feeling fully normal, they also asked me to wait at reception for a few minutes and leave only after I felt completely fine.
The place is well maintained and is only a 5 to 7 minute walk from Goregaon West railway station. I would definitely recommend it for blood donation.

Highly recommended for anyone considering blood donation!

featured_reviews.name: Akshay Kadam
featured_reviews.review_text:
BloodLine - Thane’s very own advanced blood bank. Blood Line has charted out a plan to help the needy, people who otherwise find it difficult to source blood and pay for it during an emergency. They have worked out rates that are affordable to such sections of the society. BloodLine is a non-profit organization activity involved in the betterment of the society through its high-tech yet accessible blood bank.
They are also recognised by Government of Maharashtra & State Blood Transfusion Council by giving RBTC (Regional Blood Transfusion Centre) status to Bloodline Thane.
BloodLine is the first Blood Bank in Maharashtra which is having ISO 9001:2008 Certification.
Bloodline is the only NGO run bloodbank in Konkan Division having NACO Assistance given by Ministry og Health and Family Welfare Govt. of  India, ISO Certification and Regional Blood Center Status.

Saifee Hospital Trust Blood Bank is a state-of-the-art facility located in Charni Road, Mumbai, India. It is licensed by the Central Drugs Standard Control Organization (CDSCO) for the collection, testing, processing, and storage of blood and blood components. The blood bank is open 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, and provides services to patients at Saifee Hospital and other hospitals in the Mumbai area.

Saifee Hospital Trust Blood Bank collects 100% voluntary blood donations. All blood donors are screened for eligibility and their blood is tested for a variety of diseases, including HIV, hepatitis B, hepatitis C, syphilis, and malaria. The blood bank also uses the latest technology to process and store blood safely and effectively.

Saifee Hospital Trust Blood Bank provides a wide range of blood and blood components, including:

Whole blood
Packed red cells
Saline-washed red cells
Fresh frozen plasma
Random platelet concentrate
Cryoprecipitate
Leucodepleted single donor platelet by plateletpheresis
Leukocytes by leukopheresis
Single donor plasma by plasmapheresis

The blood bank also provides a number of other services, such as:

Blood compatibility testing
Transfusion counseling
Blood component therapy
Blood product storage and transportation
Saifee Hospital Trust Blood Bank is committed to providing high-quality blood and blood components to patients in need. The blood bank has a team of experienced and qualified staff who are dedicated to ensuring the safety and efficacy of the blood products they supply.

featured_reviews.name: Dwiti Thakkar
featured_reviews.review_text:
I have voluntarily donated blood in this blood bank couple of times , however last afternoon I got a call from them stating that they have an emergency blood requirement, and if I can donate blood , I agreed, they said that I can either go by 4:00pm or tomorrow morning by 9am, since it was already 3:30 when they called and i wouldn't be able to reach in time I decided to go next morning 9am . When I reached no staff was there at the reception the two sisters were inside the ward which was a restricted area and were listening to music. I called them out loud but they didn't listen as they were engrossed in their music, i thought to call the landline, they completely ignored the landline, after waiting for 15 mins both the sisters came out. I told them I had got a call that there's an emergency hence have come for voluntary blood donation. However I was menstruating so will it be ok i donate blood. They told me they weren't aware so to wait for doctors who come at 9:30. I again waited till the doctor's arrived. None of the doctors cared to call me inside even knowing that I was waiting. After a while I asked the nurse if I could now go inside. There were 2 docs, one male n one female. The female doctor was applying make up and told me to wait for 5 more mins, and the male doctor was literally just sitting on his chair and doing nothing. I waited more it was almost 9:40 now , still they didn't have a little courtesy to call me inside. Again I went and told them sir ma'am I also have to reach to my workplace can you please now check , i asked them if I can donate blood when I was menstruating, and he just said a no. I got really annoyed and just asked him while I was waiting here for 50 mins couldn't you'll just inform me this. And why are sisters handling blood bank not aware about this basic thing? And he answered I am the doctor I know more.

After this whole incident I just had few questions.
1. Where was the emergency here? Staff including the doctors were taking their own sweet time to attend the donor
2. Staff who's handling the blood bank shouldn't have basic knowledge on blood donation?

I would rather donate blood to a hospital who value human lives n people's time.

featured_reviews.name: Farhan shaikh
featured_reviews.review_text:
Very Irresponsible Staff – Extremely Disappointed

My father undergoes dialysis at this center, and the staff here is extremely irresponsible. They do not care about the patients at all. From senior staff to junior staff, everyone only defends each other instead of addressing serious issues.

The lab technician gave my father’s insulin incorrectly three times, which caused significant blood loss. Even after complaining all three times, no action was taken against the technician. When I opposed this negligence, the staff defended the technician and even stopped me from meeting my father.

Whenever someone tries to escalate the complaint to higher authorities, they don’t allow us to meet Nitin Maniyar either. After I protested against their behavior, they even told me to take my father somewhere else if I want better treatment.

This kind of attitude is unacceptable in a medical facility. Patient safety should be their top priority, not protecting their own staff.
